title: Form Condition Expression
description: One recursive grammar with many attachment points. See docs/form-config-poc.md §6. all/any combine EXPRESSIONS; some/every quantify over REPEAT ITEMS — deliberately named differently because they are different operations.

all.description: Boolean AND over expressions. Empty array evaluates true (vacuous truth).

any.description: Boolean OR over expressions. Empty array evaluates false.

not.description: Negation. Authors never write this directly — the Hide verb compiles to it.

ref.description: Reference to a named condition on the form definition. Inlined at compile time, per design principle P3.

some.description: Existential quantifier over the items of a repeating step. Empty collection evaluates false.

every.description: Universal quantifier over the items of a repeating step. Empty collection evaluates true.

value.description: Omitted for operators of arity none; a scalar for arity single; an array for arity list.

repeatScope.description: The stepKey of a repeating step, e.g. "licensure".

oneOf.description: An answer, addressed as <stepKey>.<questionKey>. Two steps composing the same section definition therefore hold independent answers.
Within some/every, the current repetition's field.
Non-answer context. Production already gates steps by viewer role, so answers alone are not a sufficient variable space.

operator.description: `in` asks whether the answer is one of a list. `contains` asks whether an array/string answer includes a value. Kept distinct so neither operator's meaning depends on the answer's shape. `contains` also exists in production's StepCondition, so it is required for round-tripping.
